text:
alex (AE): Customer asks for a short POC on 6x A40 reserved but needs a daily guaranteed burst to 12x for a 10-day demo. Wants a one-off rate and clear convert path to a 12mo commit. Need deal-desk sign-off before SOW.

jamie (SE): Can we get exact demo window hours? That affects how much guaranteed capacity we need pinned.

alex (AE): Demo window is weekdays 0900-1200 UTC for 10 business days. They insist on guaranteed capacity during that window.

noah (Infra): Guaranteed means we must allocate the extra 6 GPUs for that window. We can do a temporary carveout or allocate through a burst-reserve SKU. Note: allocating reduces buffer for other autoscale.

jamie (SE): If we do a carveout, we should set a hard cap and list warm-up behavior in SLOs. Autoscale can cold-start in ~45s, might impact initial demo queries.

tess (Finance): For discounts we need ARR signal. POC alone doesn't justify heavy discounts. Typical POC concession: small premium on burst + conversion credit if they sign within 30 days. What's their likely ARR?

alex (AE): They indicated $300k ARR potential if expanded. Current ask is POC only.

rachel (Deal Desk): Proposed structure: charge reserved baseline at standard reserved rate, add a "POC guaranteed burst fee" per hour for pinned burst capacity, set a total burst cap, and offer a rebate of the burst fees as credits if they convert to 12mo within 45 days. Also require addendum. Draft below.

rachel (Deal Desk): ```
POC_TERM: 10 business days
BASE_COMMIT: 6x A40 (reserved)
BASE_RATE_PER_A40_HR: $3.50
POC_BURST_GUARANTEE: up to +6x during demo window
POC_BURST_FEE_PER_HR: $9.00 (flat per extra GPU hour)
POC_BURST_TOTAL_CAP: 720 hours (6 GPUs * 10 days * 12 hrs?)
CONVERSION_WINDOW: 45 days
CONVERSION_REBATE: full burst fees credited if convert to >=12mo commit within window
ADDITIONAL_TERM: signed addendum required before demo start
```

noah (Infra): Operationally: 1) confirm exact UTC window per day; 2) we need a ticket to pin capacity in provisioning; 3) if we reserve, we must tag instances to avoid accidental reallocation.

tess (Finance): The numbers look high for a POC fee but acceptable if the customer truly converts. I want to cap the rebate liability in accounting - add a maximum credit line equal to one month of reserved fees.

rachel (Deal Desk): We can add a clause: rebate capped to lesser of (burst fees paid) or (one month of committed reserved fees). Does that work?

tess (Finance): Yes, add that cap. Also require purchase order or credit card authorization upfront for the POC fees.

alex (AE): Customer agreed to PO up front. They want SOC2 and proof of KMS support. Also asked whether burst fee is negotiable.

jamie (SE): SOC2 is shareable. KMS for hosted POC: we support customer-managed keys with onboarding ticket (~2-3 biz days). For private POC we'd need extra setup.

infra-bot: Provisioning ticket created: PV-3345 to pin 6 extra A40 for demo windows. Link: https://redwood.internal/prov/PV-3345

noah (Infra): One more ops note: if demo traffic pattern spikes above demo window, autoscale will charge standard on-demand prices for additional usage. Make sure customer understands the strict window.

rachel (Deal Desk): Final action items: (1) alex to get signed POC addendum and PO, (2) noah to confirm provisioning ticket and tagging, (3) tess to produce provisional invoice with burst line and rebate cap, (4) jamie to attach SOC2 and KMS onboarding steps. I'll give conditional approval pending signed addendum and PO.

alex (AE): Sending addendum to customer now. Will post PO when received. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
